name: Forgotten Grotto
how_to_unlock: Chop down the large overgrown tree near the ranger station using a hatchet.
description: A hidden clearing with rare herbalism nodes and a secluded pond. Watch for the humor-loving hermit.

name: Sixam
how_to_unlock: Use a rocket ship to launch an expedition, or get abducted at night.
description: The alien homeworld — a green-skied lot with strange plants and abductable townies.

name: Batuu
how_to_unlock: Travel via the Batuu lot from the world selection screen.
description: A galaxy-far-far-away destination with its own currency, factions, and a working Millennium Falcon.
